q: A React effect `useEffect(() => { const id = setInterval(() => setCount(count + 1), 1000); return () => clearInterval(id); }, [])` makes the counter stop at 1. Why, and what is the minimal fix?
Two Postgres transactions update the same two rows, one in order A then B and the other B then A. What happens and how do you prevent it?
Two processes run `if (!exists(key)) insert(key)` against the same table. What goes wrong and what is the correct fix?
What does `['1','2','3'].map(parseInt)` return and why?
In Python, `def add(x, acc=[]): acc.append(x); return acc` is called twice with no acc. What does the second call return and why?
I rewound my branch by one commit with a hard reset and lost a commit I had not pushed. Can I get it back, and how?
A server listens on 127.0.0.1 and only checks that the TCP peer address is loopback. How can a malicious website still make requests to it from the victim's browser, and what check stops it?
`await Promise.all(items.map(async (i) => db.query(...)))` runs over 10,000 items and the app starts timing out on connections. Why and what is the fix?
A SQL query `SELECT c.id, COUNT(o.id) FROM c LEFT JOIN o ON o.cid = c.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id` drops customers with zero orders. Why, and what is the fix?
In React a list of inputs uses `key={index}`. After deleting the first item the wrong input keeps its typed text. Why?
A JWT library call `jwt.verify(token, publicKey)` does not pin the algorithm. What attacks does that allow?
A cron job scheduled for 02:30 local time misbehaves twice a year. Why?
In JavaScript `Math.round(1.005 * 100) / 100` gives 1 not 1.01. Why, and how do you handle money correctly?
A Node server calls `res.write(chunk)` in a loop and ignores its return value while sending a huge response to a slow client. What happens?
A local-only dev server accepts POST requests that perform an action. Why can a random website trigger it with a `text/plain` fetch even though CORS blocks reading the response?
A container exits with code 137. What does it mean and what are the two most common causes?
The regex /(a+)+$/ hangs on 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaab'. Why?
A Node service in Docker takes 10 seconds to stop on `docker stop`. Why, and what fixes it?
An async function does `const n = await getCount(); await save(n + 1);` and two requests arrive together. What is wrong and what is the fix?
A Postgres query `WHERE lower(email) = 'a@b.com'` is slow despite an index on email. Why, and what fixes it?
